'''Tharados''' was a small, cold [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Tharados system/Legends|Tharados system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Haast Aath]] ran a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Aath's slave compound|compound]] there for [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Twelve [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were also sent there during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], due to an administrative error.<ref name="Counterstrike">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Counterstrike}}</ref>
